The plate is a square plate of about 26 cm. The white mass on top looks like torn fresh mozzarella or burrata, or possibly scrambled egg white. The torn, glossy, moist look suggests fresh mozzarella, at about 250 kcal/100 g. It covers roughly 18 x 9 cm and is about 3 cm high, so I estimate about 150 g.

The golden sauce on top looks like a fruit chutney or tomatillo-style sauce with seeds. I estimate about 50 g at 70 kcal/100 g.

The fruit is watermelon chunks, strawberries and a few blueberries. I estimate about 110 g at 35 kcal/100 g.

The roasted sweet potato cubes are about 60 g at 120 kcal/100 g. A little sauce sits on them, but I count it within the sauce item.
